data.action: 对镜练习俄语情话，说完瞬间捂脸
data.description: 温泉旅馆的更衣室里，艾莉莎对着落地镜一遍遍练习那句俄语。她清了清嗓子，声音越来越小——「Я люблю тебя……不行！太害羞了！换一句换一句！」她抓起浴巾捂住发烫的脸，镜子里映出她红透的耳尖和散开的银发。
data.lighting: warm bathhouse lantern glow, soft steam haze, gentle mirror reflections
data.promptProse: She hides her flushed face behind a bath towel; the mirror reflects her red ears and loose hair. Warm lantern light diffuses through the bathhouse steam.
data.title: 艾莉莎·九条 · 镜前练习的俄语情话

data.animaCaption: The towel hides her face while the mirror reveals her red ears and loose hair.
